text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write or say. NLP is used in translation tools, which change text from one language into another quickly and accurately. It also supports sentiment analysis, where software decides whether a message is positive, negative or neutral. Another common use is chatbots, which talk with customers online and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, these systems become better every year and make our daily digital life easier.
